name: KB Financial Group Inc.
summary: KB Financial Group Inc., established in 2008 and headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, is a leading provider of comprehensive banking and financial services. The company caters to both individual consumers and corporate clients, operating across South Korea and internationally. Its extensive operations are segmented into Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, Securities Business, Non-life Insurance Business, Credit Card Business, Life Insurance Business, and Other Banking Services. KB Financial Group offers a wide array of financial products, including various loans and deposit accounts, tailored for large, small, and medium-sized enterprises, as well as for small and home offices, individuals, and households. Additionally, it provides investment banking and brokerage services, a full suite of life and non-life insurance products, and credit card facilities such as credit sales, cash services, and card loans. The group is also actively involved in securities and derivatives trading, funding activities, and associated support services. Furthermore, its diverse range of offerings encompasses foreign exchange transactions, financial investments, installment financing, financial leasing, real estate trust management, capital investment, receivables collection and credit investigation, software advisory and development, investment advisory, claims management, general management consulting, savings banking, and information and communication services.
